root_cause_1.cause: Empty strings ('') were being sent for optional UUID fields (categorie_id, site_id) instead of null. Supabase/PostgreSQL cannot parse empty string as UUID.
root_cause_1.solution: Added sanitization in supabaseApi.js to convert empty strings to null for UUID fields before insert/update

root_cause_2.cause: The devis_id field was included in the sanitization list but doesn't exist in the interventions table schema
root_cause_2.solution: Removed devis_id from the sanitization and explicitly delete it from the payload
